messages:
Jules: Hey team — prepping the SLO evidence pack for Asteria Labs' renewal next Tuesday. Need verified uptime (90d, highlight 30d), p50/p95 latency slices, and onboarding enablement signoff. Who can own what?
Maya: I can pull the uptime CSV and the per-region breakdown. Will drop a link when done.
Owen: I can export p50/p95 traces and the slow-tail samples. Which time window? last 90d ok?
Jules: Yes last 90d, please emphasize last 30d regression if any. Also call out any rollout-related blips (canary, model-swaps).
Tara: I'll attach the enablement checklist completion and the training recording links. Also have customer feedback notes on the docs they said were unclear.
Maya: pulling from reporting-db now. Query: `SELECT date, uptime_pct, region FROM sli.uptime WHERE account = 'asteria' AND date >= current_date - interval '90 days';`
Owen: grabbing traces. Will include buttons to reproduce top 3 slow requests and sample payloads.
ops-bot: NOTICE: recent deploy (r2.14) had a brief autoscale oscillation on 2026-03-14 03:02 UTC — CPU spike, no error budget burn.
Jules: Good callout — include that in the incident appendix and the mitigation notes. Ops, can you confirm if this triggered any customer-facing errors?
Maya: Confirmed: no 5xx spike, just increased latency for 8 minutes in us-west-2. I'll annotate the CSV with the exact window.
Owen: Uploaded p50/p95 artifacts to the shared folder: https://redwood-internal/slo-artifacts/asteria/1767778890
Tara: Enablement assets uploaded too. Also added a short note summarizing the doc feedback and suggested doc edits.
Jules: Awesome. For the pack we need: 1) uptime CSV + annotated window 2) latency percentiles + samples 3) incident appendix 4) enablement checklist + recordings 5) a short one-page summary for customer execs highlighting any renewal risk and proposed credits if SLO breached.
Maya: I'll draft the one-pager template and fill in numbers.
Owen: I'll add a small graph (p95 trend last 90d).
Tara: I'll write the enablement summary and proposed remediation timeline for doc gaps.
Jules: Can we have a review tomorrow AM? @Maya @Owen @Tara — target 09:30 PT review in #customer-success?
Maya: +1 09:30 PT works for me.
Owen: Works.
Tara: Works.
Jules: Thanks — tagging @ops-bot for final incident link. Once we review, I'll send the pack to AE and legal for the renewal packet. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident report link: https://redwood-internal/incidents/2026-03-14-oscillation — automated summary attached.
Jules: Perfect. If anything else crops up before the review call, drop it here. :eyes:
